title: Product smoke and real harness checks
summary: Windows and macOS product smoke and full-suite workflows run only on demand. Product smoke has Ubuntu x86, Ubuntu arm, macOS and Windows legs, and all four run the full flow: candidate wheel installation, yoke status, onboarding, hook replay and source development. There is no per-PR Windows check or required Windows merge-queue context. Targeted Windows source tests still use literal pytest.mark.windows declarations and skip unmarked modules before import. The on-demand full suite runs under the declared OS scopes. Windows shards use a pinned ripgrep executable from a checksum-verified release archive. Pytest decides the shard result, and the diagnostic artifact upload can fail without changing it.
